requirements.exact_historical_fit_and_selection: Required to reproduce actor/paired-head development and capacity repair exactly; not needed merely to re-score the already stored new requests
requirements.online_generation_and_scoring: Required to replay candidate generation or re-score saved pixels/tokens
requirements.source_restoration: All four archives are required by the original read_cache even for a train-only source role

scope: Exact existing files referenced by this control study. New runs and all new actor/critic checkpoints are already under ndu-runs/control. Repository source/protocols/allocations are preserved through Git; no entire old repository copy is required.
